steps.title: Analyze Build Failures

steps.title: Configure App Meta Info
steps.description: Align app metadata configurations with Native Image Text Replacer package parameters.

steps.description: Redesign activity_main.xml to introduce the missing OCR spinner, download statuses, progress bar, and trigger buttons.

steps.description: Maintain exact design sync inside duplicate layout files to avoid cross-compilation reference cache misses.

steps.description: Add performAdvancedOCR method signature and implementation inside EditorView.java to process online and offline detections.

steps.title: Verify Brush Removers
steps.description: Ensure brushing coordinates, coloring sample loops, and canvas draws are preserved.

steps.title: Verify Styling Handles
steps.description: Confirm dragging boundaries and text styling panels map properly with layout containers.

steps.title: Validate Image Overlays
steps.description: Inspect overlay scaling mechanisms and layout parameters.

steps.title: Check Asynchronous Processes
steps.description: Confirm internet uploader and downloader workers conform strictly to Java 8 specifications.

steps.title: Verify Layout Resource Integrity
steps.description: Execute resource compilations to confirm all IDs are verified by the auto-generated R class.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Confirm AGP 8.3.2 and Gradle 8.5 compatibility settings.

steps.title: Building Native Image Text Replacer
steps.description: Compile the complete bilingual dual-mode OCR application utilizing target environment specifications.
